review_text_raw:
the story really isn't engaging enough to justify the simple repetitive game mechanics, making it so [i]so[/i] tedious (i.e. [spoiler] take website url to find the ip and then hack the ip -> download everything -> read through everything -> rinse and repeat [/spoiler]). most damningly, there were a couple of bugs that froze my entire game--forcing me to restart the case from the beginning (since there are no manual saves).

at heart, i'm a completionist, but i don't think i'm gonna bother finishing this game.
